description: Aéroport de la Rochelle Programme de vols Hiver 2019 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Aéroport La Rochelle-Ile de Ré. This is the presentation of flight schedules departing and arriving from La Rochelle Airport, Ile de Ré for the period from 27/10/2019 to 28/03/2020 (Flight schedule for the aeronautical season Winter 2019/2020). Coverage: Aéroport La Rochelle-Ile de Ré. The portal shows the English title as "La Rochelle Airport Flight Program Winter 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Aéroport La Rochelle-Ile de Ré. Its keywords include horaires. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2019-12-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
